channel.title: Awal Global Consults Blog
channel.description: Guides on CAC registration, trademarks, tax, and compliance in Nigeria.

item.title: Nigeria Tax Act 2025: TIN, Filing, and Penalties Explained
item.description: A complete guide to Nigeria's 2025 tax reform. What the NTA and NTAA actually changed, who has to register and file, the deadlines that apply to your business, and the penalties for getting it wrong.

item.title: Complete Guide to CAC Registration in Nigeria (2026)
item.description: A plain-language guide to CAC registration in Nigeria. Business name vs limited company vs incorporated trustees, the step-by-step process, documents needed, and what happens after you register.

item.title: KYC Documentation in Nigeria: What Banks and Regulators Actually Ask For
item.description: A practical checklist of what KYC documentation Nigerian businesses need to collect from individuals, companies, and trustees, and the pieces most onboarding processes quietly miss.

item.title: Trademark Classes in Nigeria Explained: How to Choose the Right One
item.description: A plain-language guide to Nigeria's 45 trademark classes under the Nice Classification system. How they work, how to pick the right one, and what happens if you get it wrong.
